method: Pinned MT7961 scalar-source and C-RXV FAGC formulas; own-frame measurements and sanitized receive-only cross-checks
caveats: First statistics crosscheck uses historical source_field_stable label meaning endpoint equality only; equality does not prove constancy during the query.
Early register trials retain signed-byte candidates; only upper two bytes later receive firmware-backed instantaneous labels.
First HE2SS0 trial uses LTF0 and has no good-FCS receipt. Later explicitly labeled HE2SS0-LTF1 succeeds.
No ambient identifiers, payloads, raw vectors or firmware bytes exported.
